newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: VW to buy 141 mln rand S.African auto goods.
newsitem.headline: VW to buy 141 mln rand S.African auto goods.

text.p: Volkswagen AG (VW) said on Tuesday it would buy a range of automotive goods from South African companies in deals totalling 141 million rand.
The group said in a statement it would buy 60,000 car radios worth 50 million rand from Philips South Africa for Volkswagen vehicles built in Germany over the next three years.
It would also buy 85 million rands worth of electronic parts including alternators, starters and a number of subcomponents from the Bosch group.
In addition, it had signed a six million rand export contract with LUK Africa to supply 50,000 clutches to its unit Audi AG in Germany.
"The export initiatives are the latest in a series of developments since a VWSA sponsored Supplier Conference (last year)," Volkswagen said.
The conference saw 40 German industrialists examine opportunities to invest in the local automotive supply industry with a view to exporting to the Volkswagen group worldwide, it said.
